name: Naomin Ibah Lucile
original_name: ナオミン=イヴァ=ルシル
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy Second Year
Class: Dark Elf

The president of the [url=/c64356]protagonist's[/url] class at the academy. Unlike the typical Dark Elves that you may imagine, she's surprisingly diligent as a student, and pure and naive when it comes to matters of the heart. But she does harbor one dark secret... On the day of her ovulation, she goes into extreme heat! She usually skips class on those days...

As a prideful elf, she believes that all human men are perverted trash, and bears a deep hatred towards them. Her caring personality tends to attract the friendship of the clumsiest girls at the academy, so she always has her hands full looking after others.
